condition: recombinant cargo-free WT EncMh expressed in E. coli; purified assembled shell; cryo-EM characterization and X-ray crystallography (6I9G)
notes:
Canonical recombinant cargo-free WT T=1 EncMh assembly. Loncar et al. 2020 directly reported a 60-subunit icosahedral 
capsid; cryo-EM particles were ~22 nm and the 2.5 Å crystal structure 6I9G measured 23 nm with a 2.0–2.5 nm protein layer. The oligomeric shell remained stable up to 50 °C, but this is not a Tm. Heterologous cargo-loaded preparations and later EncMh fusion/loading applications are not treated as separate assemblies because no distinct shell architecture was demonstrated.
